answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in ocean, verified in summit, and forge names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 10 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 9 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
